historical_reviews.deepseek: GracefulShutdown is relevant after target/action mapping, but a final power sample cannot prove OS cooperation, stable Off or clean unmounts.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly scopes a graceful shutdown ending Off, rather than the preceding graceful reboot ending in a new boot.
historical_reviews.history: No completed review uses this exact code/variant.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The acceptance must terminate at a stable powered-off host; powering it back on is recovery evidence performed only after the Off state and shutdown artifacts have been captured.

original_test_intent: Use the BMC Orderly Shutdown control to obtain a graceful operating-system shutdown and leave the verified SUT stably powered off.
original_method: Verify the target, supported orderly action and recovery path; approve and quiesce workloads/storage; capture the live OS, filesystem and power baseline; issue one BMC Web Orderly Shutdown; observe service termination, clean unmount/shutdown and transition to stable Off within the approved timeout; preserve evidence before any separately approved power-on recovery.
manual_activity: The owner approves the shutdown window, target and Web/API method and verifies quiescence; an operator observes console/power behavior, retains control of the recovery path and owns the verdict.
required_inputs: Documented GracefulShutdown mapping if API is used
safety_requirements: Do not shut down during active writes, update or critical workload
Use protected credentials and validated target/TLS identity
Issue the orderly shutdown only once
Observe OS shutdown rather than relying solely on BMC PowerState
Do not automatically retry after rejection or timeout
Record stable Off before any recovery power-on
Stop on abrupt loss, unexpected restart, BMC loss or filesystem error
Preserve journal/kernel/SEL evidence and never clear logs
agent_execution_scope: Collect target, OS and power baseline
Operate the approved Web Orderly control or accepted equivalent once
Observe bounded graceful shutdown and Off transition
Capture retained Off and shutdown/filesystem evidence
Assist approved recovery and report without formal verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target, method, window and timeout
Control recovery power-on and resolve anomalies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: GracefulShutdown may implement the underlying action, but only after advertised support and Web-equivalence approval; a five-second delay and one `PowerState` sample do not establish orderly OS termination or stable Off.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the literal BMC Web Orderly Shutdown or an explicitly approved equivalent once, correlating OS shutdown/unmount evidence with bounded BMC power polling and stable Off retention.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Orderly mode, final shutdown and 10/20-minute estimates are preserved; automatic power-on is not added to acceptance.

modernized_recommendation.status: GRACEFUL SHUTDOWN TO EVIDENCED STABLE OFF
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a shutdown timeline from action acknowledgement through service stop, filesystem unmount, OS disappearance and persistent BMC Off state, then freeze evidence before a separately approved recovery boot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes orderly OS behavior and the stable terminal power state measurable while preserving the BMC Web operation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Redfish equivalence does not automatically test the Web control; final Off alone could result from forced loss, so OS shutdown artifacts are necessary.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A graceful request can hang or be escalated by firmware; after the host is Off, OS-side collection is unavailable and must have been staged before the transition.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define the exact graceful-shutdown signals, Off retention interval and whether API equivalence covers the WebUI case. Recovery power-on must not be mistaken for part of the source acceptance.
expected_evidence: Verified target/action mapping, approval, quiescence and recovery readiness
Pre-shutdown boot ID, uptime, service/mount/filesystem and power state
Single BMC Web Orderly action or approved equivalent response
Timestamped graceful service stop/unmount/OS-loss and power transition
Stable PowerState Off observed for the approved interval before recovery
Preserved journal/dmesg/syslog/SEL/filesystem evidence, recovery result and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently specify an orderly shutdown ending in the powered-off state.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target/action mapping, quiescence, timeout, stable-Off oracle and recovery are normal owner-controlled execution inputs; the source objective is identifiable.

review_improvement: Separates graceful OS termination from the BMC's final power indication and from later recovery, preventing a forced loss or transient Off sample from satisfying Orderly Shutdown.
independent_technical_reasoning: Orderly shutdown has two necessary properties: the OS must complete its shutdown path and the chassis must remain Off. Evidence for only the second cannot distinguish GracefulShutdown from ForceOff. Because OS access disappears by design, filesystem and journal capture must be prepared before the action and correlated with the BMC transition afterward.
